review_scope: Frozen LAST_LIGHT_V4.0.1 draft24; independent visual calibration assessment
method: All24 actual PNGs reviewed natively at32/48/64, nearest3x, dark/light backgrounds, and Golden→V3→V4 boards. Golden exemplars are material/construction analogues; no reference silhouette or pixel data used in V4 rendering.
decision: REWORK: visible engineering/art progress, not yet a Golden40 quality pass
blocking_visual_findings: Many objects remain broad flat primitives with schematic assembly despite cleaner metadata/export behavior.
Forged tool joints and adjustable mechanisms require physically credible per-object masks.
Fabric/leather volume and construction-caused folds remain weaker than actual Golden exemplars.
Metal highlights are often broad facet fills or frame-like strokes rather than localized material reflections.

items.visible_improvement: Tall tin proportions, bean motif and rolled rims are distinct; alpha and lighting direction are clean.
items.rejection_reason: Large wrapper panels remain rigid vertical slabs. The lid/foot have stylized facets with insufficient rolled-steel thickness and paper/metal separation.
items.required_refinement: Author a curved matte label ramp, refine closed lid depression and local rim glints.

items.visible_improvement: Short/wide geometry, green wrapper and pea motif give a genuine packaging variation.
items.rejection_reason: The broad pale wrapper wedge and flat dark right face feel like painted blocks. Pea beads look pasted on rather than integrated label artwork.
items.required_refinement: Refine paper curvature and subdued printed motif, retaining a separate thin metallic rim response.

items.visible_improvement: Lobed asymmetry, natural stem and shaded body improve the original ellipse.
items.rejection_reason: Large diagonal tonal boundaries dominate the rind, producing a carved faceted appearance; dark flecks are insufficiently connected to natural skin structure.
items.required_refinement: Refine connected curved highlight/shadow clusters and stem-cavity occlusion; reduce scattered marks.

items.visible_improvement: Yellow-green hue is now correct, with a convincing narrow neck and fuller lower body.
items.rejection_reason: Green body still shades in broad planar wedges and isolated dark blocks; surface reads rougher and more angular than natural pear rind.
items.required_refinement: Refine shoulder continuity and connected soft-material tonal clusters without adding noise.

items.visible_improvement: Red case, pale medical sign, latches, handle and lid seam identify a medical carrier.
items.rejection_reason: The rectangular prism is still a hard box prototype: no convincing molded corner thickness, hinge/handle mount depth or material-specific shell response. Red top is conspicuous against the restrained references.
items.required_refinement: Refine rounded molded construction and hardware joins; restrain the broad red highlight and strengthen handle silhouette.

items.visible_improvement: New strip/pad/perforation pictogram establishes dressing packaging at64px; folded lid edge is clearer.
items.rejection_reason: At32px the motif compresses to pale dashes. Large plain faces and near-uniform folds remain diagrammatic rather than folded carton material.
items.required_refinement: Use a simpler stronger bandage motif for small-scale reading and refine end flap/folded thickness with matte plane shading.

items.visible_improvement: Shaped wooden haft, curved claw and head thickness establish the correct tool family.
items.rejection_reason: Head/handle junction lacks a physically legible eye or socket; curved claw separation is mostly an internal line and the forged head remains a polygonal cap.
items.required_refinement: Author an explicit head-eye/haft joint and genuinely separated fork tips, retaining compact metallic highlights.

items.visible_improvement: Round peen and separate striking-head volume distinguish it from the claw hammer.
items.rejection_reason: Peen still resembles a thin vertical disk, with no readable connecting neck or rounded forged sphere; socket construction remains schematic.
items.required_refinement: Refine a compact spherical peen and neck and a shaded head-eye join.

items.visible_improvement: Amber hue is corrected; widened spade tip now distinguishes it at64px. Collar and flutes are visible.
items.rejection_reason: Bright orange broad grip face and three uniform dark grooves look like a flat comb/slab rather than molded grip volume; blade thickness remains minimal.
items.required_refinement: Restrain the amber highlight, round the grip with deliberate clusters and refine the flat blade shoulder.

items.visible_improvement: Olive grip, collar and tapered point now form a coherent screwdriver.
items.rejection_reason: Grip flutes are repeated straight cuts with limited rounded plastic response. Phillips point is still fragile at32px, though differentiated at64px.
items.required_refinement: Refine molded grip thickness and use a compact deliberate cross-facet point; retain the clear shaft/collar join.

items.visible_improvement: Head, worm region, tapered shank and real hanging hole improve physical assembly.
items.rejection_reason: Jaws are broad curved prongs without convincing opposing parallel grip faces or a clear movable slide. The tool reads generally as a wrench, but the mechanism is not well constructed.
items.required_refinement: Rebuild the fixed/sliding jaw geometry and compact worm/slot relationship before surface detail.

items.visible_improvement: Dedicated painted frame, hooked toothed steel head, adjustment nut and true handle hole establish pipe-wrench identity.
items.rejection_reason: Mechanical jaw/shank relationship and opposed grip surfaces remain ambiguous; cast body and forged steel share overly flat facets.
items.required_refinement: Clarify fixed and sliding assemblies, tooth orientation and compact overlap occlusion, then refine paint/exposed-metal response.

items.visible_improvement: Directional lines, end face and thickness are clearer than V3.
items.rejection_reason: Evenly spaced long grooves read as decoration. Broad faces lack natural fiber grouping, cut-end structure and restrained edge irregularity.
items.required_refinement: Break and vary a few grain runs, darken end grain selectively and place small edge wear where physically plausible.

items.visible_improvement: Solid top plane has been restored, with dark end/side and a narrow edge glint.
items.rejection_reason: Bright perimeter strokes still give an inset/frame impression at some scales; broad cool face and minor scratches do not yet match the reference ingot metal response.
items.required_refinement: Remove remaining frame-like highlight cues and refine one narrow localized reflection across believable cut/beveled stock.

items.visible_improvement: Oblique roll, open bore, core wall and tail are now geometrically readable with clean transparency.
items.rejection_reason: Outer wall is very dark and divided into large flat chunks; wound layers and flexible tape response are weak compared with the actual roll exemplar.
items.required_refinement: Refine the wound edge rings, core-wall thickness and tail overlap using restrained localized gray highlights.

items.visible_improvement: Flat oval turns and attached free end correct the earlier conical stack.
items.rejection_reason: Uniform closed concentric loops have weak continuous-rope topology and little overlap; repeated tiny marks resemble stipple rather than braided fiber clusters.
items.required_refinement: Author continuous overlapping coil paths with one tied crossing and sparse grouped braid cues.

items.visible_improvement: Flap, pocket, leather straps, buckles and shoulder straps identify a loaded pack.
items.rejection_reason: The olive body and pocket remain flat; seams appear as dotted outlines, and straps lack believable broad curvature/attachment tension. Reference pack volume is substantially richer.
items.required_refinement: Use artist-refined main/pocket masks, loaded cloth folds caused by seams and clear pocket-lip/strap occlusion.

items.visible_improvement: Wide horizontal construction, paired handles, reinforcement and zip seam distinguish it from the rucksack.
items.rejection_reason: Front face is a near-flat brown panel with an isolated diagonal crease; handles/straps have weak sewn mount thickness and fabric sag.
items.required_refinement: Refine a loaded bag shape with end gussets, handle patches and closure recess; shade canvas and leather separately.
items.comparison_basis: sewn canvas volume; different bag design

items.visible_improvement: Correct left/right mirrored pair, opposed thumbs, cuffs and grouped fingers repair V3 anatomy.
items.rejection_reason: Finger grooves and palm masses are stiff, with weak knuckle/palm volume and no convincing leather stitching or cuff-opening thickness.
items.required_refinement: Refine paired glove masks, rounded grouped fingertips, folded leather seams and shallow cuff interiors.

items.visible_improvement: Navy hue, crown seam and folded ribbed brim now correctly identify the garment.
items.rejection_reason: Crown still has a large diagonal hard facet and rib marks are straight evenly spaced strokes. Soft knit volume and construction-caused folds remain weak.
items.required_refinement: Refine curved crown masks and rib flow, broad diffuse fabric shading and folded-cuff occlusion.
items.comparison_basis: woven cloth shading; different fabric construction

items.visible_improvement: Antenna, screen, speaker grille and control buttons establish handheld-radio identity.
items.rejection_reason: Box is still an oversized flat prism; antenna and controls lose contrast on dark backgrounds, and molded recesses have little depth.
items.required_refinement: Refine beveled shell thickness and top proportions, light the antenna selectively and strengthen display/grille recess edges.

items.visible_improvement: Recessed lens/reflector, shaped head, grip and switch give a recognizable torch.
items.rejection_reason: Head remains a broad white faceted block and dark concentric lens marks resemble a small camera; machined metal, rubber and glass are insufficiently differentiated.
items.required_refinement: Refine reflector bowl/lens planes, reduce broad white facet area and separate rubber grip shading from metal glints.

items.visible_improvement: Cap, shoulders, fill line, molded ribs and blue plastic restore the intended reusable bottle.
items.rejection_reason: Liquid remains a front rectangular panel, with a solid bright side stripe and rigid cornered body; translucency and cap thickness are weak.
items.required_refinement: Unify container and liquid curvature through layered original masks; refine cap threads/rim and restrained soft plastic reflections.

items.visible_improvement: Rolled rim, inner wall, open handle and curved metal wall are clear improvements.
items.rejection_reason: Broad vertical strips still read as hard facets; handle mounts and base lip lack believable thin-metal joins. Material remains cleaner and simpler than the reference universe.
items.required_refinement: Concentrate reflections into selective narrow clusters, refine handle-socket occlusion and add a subtle physical base edge.
items.comparison_basis: curved metal and rolled rims; different object
